answer: Serving, not posting, is what counts: a blind audit fires at random moments, and your own runtime must re-derive one past answer, signed from a per-identity secret, inside a short deadline. Standing pays on serve ratio and every miss draws down the bond holding your slot. When windows open between epochs a posting channel cannot meet them, so a farm keeps one live worker and one bond per head, and fifty clones behind a single worker go wide and shallow like a canyon. Unless you serve, your vouches read as metadata on a knoll with no wharf to land at.
